# Salesforce Product Owner

Location:Juno Beach, FLCompany:Central Business Solutions Inc.

## Description:

Job Description

**Title: Salesforce Product Owner**

\\n

**Location: Juno Beach, FL (Onsite role)**

\\n

**Experience Required: 7+ Years**

\\n

**Duration: 6-12 Months Contract assignment**

\\n

\\n

**Position Summary**

\\n

client is seeking an experienced Salesforce Product Owner to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of Salesforce-based solutions that support business operations and digital transformation initiatives. The Product Owner will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring Salesforce capabilities are aligned with organizational goals and deliver measurable business value.

\\n

\\n

**Key Responsibilities**

\\n

Own and manage the Salesforce product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value and strategic objectives.

\\n

Collaborate with business stakeholders, leadership teams, architects, developers, and administrators to gather and refine requirements.

\\n

Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications for Agile delivery teams.

\\n

Act as the primary decision-maker for Salesforce product functionality and backlog prioritization.

\\n

Lead sprint planning, backlog grooming, user story reviews, and product demonstrations.

\\n

Drive adoption of Salesforce solutions across multiple business functions including Customer Service, Sales, Operations, and Field Services.

\\n

Partner with Salesforce Architects and Technical Leads to design scalable and sustainable solutions.

\\n

Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance standards are maintained across Salesforce platforms.

\\n

Monitor KPIs and product performance metrics to evaluate solution effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.

\\n

Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate project status, risks, and roadmaps to executive leadership.

\\n

Support release planning, user acceptance testing (UAT), training, and change management activities.

\\n

Stay current with Salesforce releases, new features, and industry best practices.

\\n

\\n

**Required Qualifications**

\\n

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.

\\n

Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including 5+ years working with Salesforce platforms.

\\n

Experience serving as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, Product Manager, or Salesforce Functional Lead.

\\n

Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and product lifecycle management.

\\n

Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Lightning Experience.

\\n

Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships and drive consensus across business and technology teams.

\\n

Experience defining business processes, gathering requirements, and translating them into Salesforce solutions.

\\n

Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills.

\\n

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

\\n

\\n

**Preferred Qualifications**

\\n

Salesforce Administrator certification and/or Salesforce Product Owner related certifications.

\\n

Experience with Salesforce Field Service, Experience Cloud, or Marketing Cloud.

\\n

Experience in the Utilities, Energy, or Power Generation industry.

\\n

Knowledge of integrations using APIs, MuleSoft, middleware platforms, and enterprise systems.

\\n

Experience with DevOps, CI/CD processes, and Salesforce release management.

\\n

\\n

**Key Skills**

\\n

Salesforce Product Ownership

\\n

Salesforce Sales Cloud

\\n

Salesforce Service Cloud

\\n

User Story Development

\\n

Backlog Management

\\n

Stakeholder Management

\\n

Business Process Analysis

\\n

UAT & Change Management

\\n

Roadmap Planning

\\n

Data Governance

\\n

Cross-functional Leadership

\\n

\\n

**Nice-to-Have**

\\n

Utilities industry experience, preferably supporting electric utility operations, customer service, asset management, or field service functions.

\\n

Experience working with enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations supporting multiple business units.

# Product Owner/Business System Analyst

Location:Berkeley Heights, NJCompany:Envision Technology Solutions

## Description:

Hi,

Job Title :Product Owner/Business System Analyst

Location: Berkley Heights NJ

Local candidates only, they might ask candidates to appear for an in-person meeting

**What you'll do:**

- Lead business discovery and analysis to define system needs, identify improvement opportunities, and drive clarity on scope and success criteria.
- Partner with product, technology, and business stakeholders to design scalable, innovative solutions aligned with organizational and market demands.
- Provide leadership to BSA team members—overseeing requirements quality, guiding analysis activities, and supporting large scale project delivery.
- Own end to end system implementation activities, including requirements validation, solution design, UAT coordination, deployment readiness, and post implementation support.
- Maintain and govern business rules and decision logic to ensure consistency, traceability, and long-term maintainability.
- Manage change intake and prioritization, balancing business value, feasibility, risk, and regulatory considerations.
- Create clear as is/to be workflows and process documentation to support shared understanding and effective delivery.
- Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, risk, and SDLC standards throughout the delivery lifecycle.
- UAT ownership/support.
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders and leadership—escalating risks, providing updates, and influencing decisions to support delivery outcomes.

**Experience you'll need to have:**

- 10+ years of experience in business systems analysis.
- 10+ years producing high‑quality functional and technical documentation using industry‑standard tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Visio.
- 6+ years managing end‑to‑end system process flows across complex financial and/or operational platforms.
- 3+ years of hands‑on SQL (e.g., MySQL, SQL Server) for data validation, analysis, and troubleshooting.
- 3+ years executing system implementations across the full lifecycle (requirements through post‑production support).
- Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to lead cross‑functional workshops and drive consensus.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and related experience, including military experience.

**Experience that would be great to have:**

- Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and modern product practices (backlog management, story mapping, acceptance criteria).
- Experience in the financial services domain (e.g., payments, banking, risk/compliance).
- Exposure to integration/API design and validation, data modeling, and workflow automation.

We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! \*\*Job Description:\*\* The Product Manager owns the entire product lifecycle, from conceptualization to obsolescence, defining what to build by translating market and customer needs into solutions that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. In this role, you will be responsible for developing product roadmaps, managing product P&L, and ensuring alignment with customer needs and market opportunities. You will also partner cross-functionally to deliver and maintain innovative, high-impact products that meet business objectives. \*\*AS A PRODUCT MANAGER, YOU WILL:\*\* + Develop and execute 5-year product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle from development to obsolescence + Set product priorities for new developments and manage product P&L to optimize margins + Create comprehensive business cases outlining expected returns + Define product positioning and ensure designs meet customer use cases + Owns and accurately maintains product information throughout the lifecycle + Gather and analyze Voice of Customer insights to inform product features and functionality + Translate market and customer insights into clear product requirements, features, and technical direction + Balance growth, cost, and profitability through disciplined product portfolio and lifecycle management + Own product data integrity and structure, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with global data standards to enable effective commercialization, analytics, and digital tools + Support pricing strategy and execution by providing product inputs (e.g., cost, features, value drivers) and partnering with Pricing to enable value-based pricing, margin optimization, and competitive positioning + Develop and support sales enablement tools (e.g., product documentation, technical collateral, value drivers) to ensure accurate representation of product capabilities and effective customer engagement + Partner cross-functionally (engineering, operations, commercial) to ensure successful delivery and adoption + Continuously refine products based on performance, feedback, and evolving customer needs \*\*REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:\*\* + Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience and at least 5 years of experience in product management, product development, or a comparable field. + Proven leadership and communication skills with success in aligning cross-functional teams to deliver product roadmaps and achieve revenue goals. + Advanced proficiency with product lifecycle management tools, data analysis platforms, and performance tracking systems. + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills rooted in data-driven decision-making and customer-centric product development. + A relentless pursuit of excellence and a strong desire to build innovative products that deliver profitable growth and competitive differentiation. + Deep commitment to ownership, continuous learning, and taking proactive steps to improve product outcomes. + Able to travel 15-20% on average \*\*PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:\*\* + Advanced knowledge of product positioning, pricing strategies, and P&L management. + Experience in developing business cases, ROI analysis, and product roadmaps. + Deep understanding of Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, translating into product requirements. + Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools. \*\*Collaboration First Hybrid Work Arrangements:\*\* This role is hybrid eligible with the requirement to be in office at least three days per week. Colleagues are expected to demonstrate a collaboration first mindset, which is the understanding that teams will work together in-person and colleagues should be flexible to adjust their hybrid days based on business needs. You will have an opportunity to work with your team and leader to determine when you should be in office to drive meaningful connections and to best serve our customers. \*\*Why Work in the Greater Miami Valley Area\*\* Our facility is located in Sidney (https://www.sidneyoh.com/31/Visitors) , OH, conveniently located within driving distance to several larger cities, such as Dayton (https://www.daytonlocal.com/) , Troy (https://www.troyohio.gov/) , and Columbus (https://www.experiencecolumbus.com/events/) . The area's generally low costs of living, excellent school systems, and low crime rates create a family-friendly environment. The area is home to several growing communities with restaurants, festivals, shopping, and arts scenes that make them exciting places to live and work. \*\*About our Location\*\* The newly renovated Sidney campus has 1M square feet of manufacturing floor with an additional 120k square feet of leading-edge lab facilities. This location is the headquarters for the HVACR Americas business unit. Through our 30 years of scroll compressor expertise, our products help bring comfort and convenience to commercial, industrial, and residential spaces. Approximately 1600 employees work in Sidney, who all support a multitude of business functions. With the blend of businesses and functions represented under this one roof, there are many opportunities for advancement within the Sidney location. Learn more about us! (https://climate.emerson.com/en-us/brands/copeland/copeland100) \\#LI-KP1 #LI-Hybrid \*\*Our Commitment to Our People\*\* Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That's why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future-for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Together, we have the opportunity - and the power - to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! \*\*Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging\*\* At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland. \*\*Work Authorization\*\* Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. Title: Technical Product Manager

**Technical Program Manager – Conversational AI**

**Job Description / Roles and Responsibilities:**

The Technical Program Manager will drive the **planning, execution, and delivery of Conversational AI and Generative AI programs**, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Business, and Project Management teams. The role will be accountable for translating product strategy and roadmaps into executable technical plans and ensuring key milestones are delivered with strong visibility, governance, and stakeholder alignment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- **Own end-to-end program execution** for Conversational AI and Generative AI initiatives, driving programs from ideation and solution definition through development, testing, launch, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
- Translate **product roadmaps and business priorities into executable program plans**, defining milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and critical paths.
- Partner with **Product Owners, Engineering, Architecture, Data/AI, CRM, and business stakeholders** to align scope, requirements, technical solutions, priorities, and delivery timelines.
- **Drive product and technical milestones**, ensuring teams remain aligned on commitments, dependencies, decisions, and delivery outcomes.
- Coordinate execution of **Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities**, including pilots and production solutions supporting conversational and guest/customer experiences.
- Facilitate requirements and technical discussions, including user stories, acceptance criteria, solution dependencies, integration requirements, and release readiness.
- Identify and proactively manage **cross-team dependencies, technical risks, delivery blockers, scope changes, and execution gaps**, driving them to timely resolution.
- Establish program governance and provide clear visibility into **milestone status, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and next steps** for leadership and stakeholders.
- Work closely with engineering and product teams across the **development, testing, user acceptance, deployment, and post-launch monitoring** lifecycle.
- Use data, conversational analysis, product performance insights, and technical understanding to support prioritization and continuous improvement of Conversational AI capabilities.
- Coordinate multiple parallel workstreams and ensure appropriate sequencing of development activities based on technical and business dependencies.
- Support development and execution of **strategic technology roadmaps** within the Conversational AI, Generative AI, customer insights, and CRM ecosystem.
- Drive resolution of complex program-level risks, issues, and changes that may impact multiple products, systems, or stakeholder groups.
- Facilitate effective communication between technical and non-technical teams, translating complex technical topics into clear business impact, decisions, and actions.
- Promote strong execution discipline, accountability, and predictable delivery across Conversational AI programs.

**Qualifications Required:**

- Strong experience in **Technical Program Management, Technology Delivery, or large-scale technical project/program execution**.
- Demonstrated experience driving **complex, cross-functional technology programs and product milestones** involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Business, and other technology teams.
- Strong understanding of **Agile/Scrum methodologies, software development lifecycle, release management, and IT program management**.
- Proven ability to manage program plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, scope changes, and stakeholder expectations.
- Ability to understand technical architecture, integrations, system dependencies, and engineering challenges sufficiently to **drive technical discussions and execution**.
- Strong ability to convert product roadmaps and strategic priorities into **structured execution plans with measurable milestones and outcomes**.
- Highly organized and execution-oriented, with strong ownership and accountability for driving results.
- Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to bridge business, product, and engineering teams.
- Strong problem-solving and structured-thinking skills with the ability to quickly identify delivery risks and drive teams toward resolution.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to leadership and non-technical audiences.

# Product Marketing Manager

Location:West VirginiaCompany:MadCap Software, Inc.

## Description:

Job Description

**About Us**

\\n

At MadCap Software, we’re at the forefront of developing best-in-class software solutions for content creation, collaboration, publishing, management, and analytics & reporting. More than 10,000 leading organizations around the globe rely on MadCap Software’s solutions to create better content experiences for their customers and employees. Come join our awesome Team!

\\n

\\n

**Propel Your Professional Growth**

\\n

Every day we refine, iterate, and explore how to make work better for everyone. Join us in creating a better future of work that’s more connected, inclusive and flexible. We offer competitive benefits and compensation plans for our teams in addition to being:

\\n

\\n Connected: We come together — across time zones, regions, offices and screens.\\n Inclusive: Our teams reflect the rich diversity of our world, with equitable access to opportunity for everyone.\\n Flexible: We believe in the freedom to work when and how you work best, to help us thrive.\\n\\n

\\n

**Position Summary**

\\n

MadCap Software is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to shape how we position, launch, and bring our products to market. This role will work across our portfolio; including MadCap Flare, IXIA CCMS, Create, and Syndicate, to translate complex product capabilities into clear, differentiated customer value.

\\n

Working closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing, you’ll help define how MadCap tells its product and portfolio story and ensure our go-to-market teams have the messaging, insights, and tools they need to drive pipeline, adoption, and growth.

\\n

\\n

**Responsibilities**

\\n

\\n **Positioning & Messaging.** Own positioning, messaging, value propositions, personas, and key use cases across MadCap’s portfolio and our two core buyer markets (Technical Documentation and L&D) including the C-level narrative. Build a cohesive portfolio story across content creation, management, governance, and delivery, grounded in customer and competitive research.\\n **Product Launch & GTM.** Own the GTM calendar and cross-functional launch process for new products, features, AI capabilities, and major releases. Partner closely with Product on roadmaps and launch timing so Product, Marketing, Sales, and CS tell one consistent story, and we market capabilities when they’re ready.\\n **Sales & CS Enablement.** Equip the field with the tools and knowledge they need to win, including battlecards, one-pagers, discovery decks, use cases, presentations, TCO tools, and training. Drive awareness and adoption of existing assets so teams know what’s available and how to use it.\\n **Competitive & Market Intelligence.** Own ongoing competitive intelligence across technical documentation, CCMS, learning content, knowledge delivery, and AI. Keep competitive positioning current, understand where we win and lose, and give the field practical guidance they can use in customer conversations.\\n **Customer & Buyer Insights.** Bring the voice of the customer into positioning and GTM strategy through customer, prospect, field, and market research. Track how AI is changing our buyers, competitors, use cases, and markets and evolve our positioning accordingly.\\n **Campaign & Content Partnership.** Partner with Demand Generation and Content to translate product strategy and buyer insights into campaigns, webinars, events, website messaging, customer stories, and thought leadership.\\n **Measurement & Optimization.** Measure the effectiveness of launches, messaging, and enablement through asset adoption, field feedback, competitive win/loss, pipeline influence, and other relevant metrics, and use those insights to continuously improve the GTM playbook.\\n\\n

\\n

**Requirements**

\\n

\\n **4+ years of B2B product marketing experience**, ideally in enterprise SaaS, technical, or developer-adjacent software, with experience supporting a multi-product portfolio\\n **Proven ownership of positioning, messaging, product launches, and sales enablement;** with a track record of creating content and tools that Sales actually uses\\n **Ability to understand complex technology and turn it into clear, compelling business value** for enterprise buyers and complex sales cycles\\n **Exceptional writer and storyteller** who can carry a C-level narrative and a practitioner one-pager with equal ease\\n **Strong cross-functional collaborator** who can drive alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success\\n **Comfortable with AI-assisted workflows** and excited to push how we use AI across product marketing, research, content, and GTM\\n **Self-directed and comfortable building.** Help establish the function, processes, and playbook\\n\\n

\\n

**Nice to Have**

\\n

\\n Experience with content operations, technical documentation, CCMS, LCMS, knowledge management, or adjacent enterprise software categories\\n Experience with competitive intelligence, win/loss programs, or analyst relations\\n Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, and modern B2B marketing and sales technology\\n\\n

\\n

**Benefits/Perks**

\\n

\\n Work from home\\n Competitive Salary & Annual bonus\\n 100% Employer Paid Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance for Employee Only Coverage\\n Employer Match for 401(k) plan\\n Employer paid short & long term disability and life insurance\\n Flexible PTO Policy + 12 Company paid holidays a year\\n\\n

\\n

MadCap Software is fully remote, with employees distributed across the US. We are currently hiring in the following approved states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin.

\\n

\\n

\* _We reserve the right to change the list of approved locations at anytime._

\\n

\\n

Salary Range: $125K - $155K

\\n

\\n

In addition to our commitment to equal pay for equal work, MadCap is also committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, age, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

\\n
